task: Remove Authority bundle generation from the public Lattice CLI while preserving bundle consumption.
outcome: The CLI no longer creates basic or senior Authority bundle files, but existing env/trust-file parsing and receipt paths continue to work with server-provided files.
facts: Current CLI code contains buildAuthorityTrustProfileBundle and tests that write lattice_authority_trust.env, lattice_staging-client.env, and senior filenames.
The product boundary is now server-generated files, public CLI consumer-only.
Normal developers should not need PROJECT_ID or GATE_ACTOR variables unless they enter explicit live runner or receipt/gate-consumption flows.
Server-side bundle generation is tracked in Lattice Authority Server story B-42a2.
constraints: Do not move server generation logic into the public CLI repo.
Do not break parsing/consumption of server-provided authority_trust.env or lattice_* env files.
Only update docs and tests that currently describe or exercise local generation.
Do not optimize unrelated authority receipt or gate logic in this cleanup story.
